guide.title: Amnir WANAS
guide.subtitle: Steqsi s teqbaylit, s taɛrabt, s tderǧa, s tefransist neɣ s teglizit.

guide.error: Amnir ur yezmir ara ad d-yerr. Ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen.

guide.photoHint: Ṭṭef tugna n wemkan, WANAS ad t-yissin ad d-yeḥku ɣef-s.
guide.unidentified: Ur ssineɣ ara amkan-a s tḥeqqi. Atan wayen i d-yezzin.

ar.title: Tilawt tessemɣeṛ i uzref
ar.subtitle: Sekcem takamiṛat ɣer tecreḍt n WANAS akken ad d-tban tlalit n wemkan aqbur.
ar.step1: Sken-d tacreḍt — ɣef ugdil-nniḍen neɣ tettwasiggez.
ar.step2: Serreḥ i tkamiṛat mi ara k-testeqsi tnarit.
ar.step3: Sekcem tiliɣri-k ɣer tecreḍt, ger 30 d 50 sm.
ar.markerHint: Sken-d tugna-a ɣef ugdil ummid neɣ siggez-itt.
cameraHelp: Asebter ilaq ad d-yekk seg HTTPS neɣ localhost; takamiṛat ur teddu ara seg ufaylu yeldin srid.
Serreḥ i tkamiṛat deg yiɣewwaren n tnarit.

common.offlineHint: Tiririyin yebnan ɣef udlis n uzref adigan, war azeṭṭa.
common.apiDown: API n WANAS ur d-tettwaf ara. Sekker-itt s docker compose up.
